description: Test suite for upload-related API endpoints in Mattermost, including upload creation, retrieval, and data upload, with various permission and configuration checks.

methods.name: TestCreateUpload
methods.description: Tests for creating uploads with various permission and configuration scenarios, including size limits and cloud restrictions.

methods.name: TestGetUpload
methods.description: Tests for retrieving upload sessions by ID, including permission checks and not found cases.

methods.name: TestGetUploadsForUser
methods.description: Tests for listing uploads for a specific user, including permission restrictions and empty results.

methods.name: TestUploadData
methods.description: Tests for uploading file data, including success, permission issues, cloud restrictions, and resume functionality.

methods.name: TestUploadDataMultipart
methods.description: Tests for uploading file data via multipart form, including success and resume functionality.
